# Lumière Cinema

> Decentralized, frame-accurate private cinema and synchronized watch party platform with WebRTC voice/video and multi-track audio transcoding.

Lumière is an open-source, self-hostable private theater platform designed to replicate the experience of sitting together in a private screening room. It features sub-second frame-accurate playback synchronization, integrated multi-track MKV on-the-fly audio transcoding via FFmpeg, WebRTC mesh voice and video cams, and universal browser extension support for OTT platforms (Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar, Zee5).

## Core Capabilities
- **Frame-Accurate Playback Synchronization**: Sub-frame rate steering (0.95x - 1.06x) via Socket.IO heartbeats without pitch distortion.
- **Multi-Track Audio & Subtitle Engine**: Server-side FFmpeg pipeline extracts, transcodes, and switches DTS, TrueHD, E-AC3 audio tracks and VTT/SRT subtitles on-the-fly.
- **WebRTC Mesh Voice & Video**: Low-latency peer-to-peer audio and webcam video grid running on dedicated peer connections independent of media streaming.
- **Floating Windows**: Windows-style draggable and 8-way resizable window manager for the theater screen and participant webcam tiles.
- **Clean URL Slugs & Room Routing**: Direct room joining via `/room/:roomId` or short slug `/r/:roomId`.
- **OTT Streaming Platform Bridge**: Native browser extension bridging synchronous playback across Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hotstar, and Zee5.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Fluent-FFmpeg, Self-signed SSL, HTTP Gzip/Brotli Compression.
- **Frontend**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES2022), Hardware-accelerated CSS3 OLED Cinema HUD, WebRTC (RTCPeerConnection), Web Audio API, Full PWA manifest.
- **Mobile**: Android WebView client with custom asset packaging (`lumiere.apk`).

## Public REST API Endpoints
- `GET /api/info`: Server network topology, local IP, Tailscale IP, and ports.
- `GET /api/movies`: Enumerates available local cinema library files (.mkv, .mp4, .webm).
- `POST /api/upload`: Direct drag-and-drop movie upload to server.
- `POST /api/feedback`: Community feedback submission.
- `GET /api/extension/info`: Browser extension manifest and supported platform list.
- `GET /api/extension/download`: Dynamic ZIP bundle of the browser sync extension.
